title: Parsley Health floating pill
description: A forest pill with an arrow fixed near the bottom of the window: full width on phones, centred on desktop. It stays out of sight over the first screen, then fades in and rises 16px as the page is scrolled past it.
notes: position: fixed; put it once per page
the entrance is a CSS scroll timeline on the page; without support (or with reduced motion) the pill is always shown
